blocks.text: Grade 6 高频词汇 501–520
expend /ik'spend/ v.t. 花费, 消耗, 用光
Even standing robots "are expending quite a bit of energy," Ting says.
中文语境：丁说，即使是站立的机器人"也会消耗相当多的能量"
institute /'institjuːt/ n. 学会, 学院, 协会；v.t. 创立, 开始, 制定, 任命
Ting and Young-Hui Chang of the Georgia Institute of Technology (also in Atlanta) tested balance in Chilean flamingos.
中文语境：佐治亚理工学院（也在亚特兰大）的 Ting 和 Young-Hui Chang 在智利火烈鸟身上测试了平衡能力
appreciative /ə'priːʃiətiv/ adj. 有欣赏力的, 感激的
So the next time the NWS accurately predicts a clap of thunder - or anything else - be sure to give the agency some appreciative claps of your own.
中文语境：因此，下次国家气象局准确预测雷声或其他任何事情时，请务必向该机构发出一些赞赏的掌声
forecast /'fɒːkɑːst/ n. 预想, 预测, 预报；v.t. 预想, 预测, 预报；[计] 趋势预测
The NWS is the federal agency that provides weather, hydrologic (water-related) and climate forecasts and warnings for the nation, including U.S.
中文语境：NWS 是为全国（包括美国）提供天气、水文（与水相关）和气候预报和警报的联邦机构
insemination /in.semi'neiʃən/ n. 播种, 受胎, 授精；[医] 授精
Edward was the first southern white rhino born through artificial insemination in the United States.
中文语境：爱德华是美国第一头通过人工授精出生的南方白犀牛
reproductive /.riːprə'dʌktiv/ adj. 生殖的, 再生的, 复制的；[医] 生殖的, 复现的

"Even though he doesn't know it's his birthday, it is very special to see Edward-a healthy, robust rhino-running around, enjoying his special treats," shared Barbara Durrant Henshaw, the Director of Reproductive Sciences at the San Diego Zoo.
中文语境：圣地亚哥动物园生殖科学主任芭芭拉·杜兰特·亨肖 (Barbara Durrant Henshaw) 表示："尽管爱德华不知道今天是他的生日，但看到爱德华--一头健康、强壮的犀牛跑来跑去，享受着他的特殊待遇，真是太特别了。"
embryo /'embriəu/ n. 胚胎, 胎儿, 胚芽；[医] 胚, 胚胎
Scientists hope that these embryos can one day be implanted in the womb of a southern white rhino.
中文语境：科学家希望这些胚胎有一天能够被植入南方白犀牛的子宫中
manipulate /mə'nipjuleit/ v.t. 操纵, 利用, 操作, 巧妙地处理, 假造
Scientists hope that they can manipulate rhino stem cells into sperm and eggs.
中文语境：科学家希望他们能够将犀牛干细胞转化为精子和卵子
bleak /bliːk/ adj. 萧瑟的, 荒凉的, 阴冷的
For the northern white rhino, the situation is far bleaker.
中文语境：对于北方白犀牛来说，情况要黯淡得多
pathogen /'pæθədʒ(ə)n/ n. 病原体；[医] 病原体
In zoonotic diseases, animals serve as a pathogen's host .
中文语境：在人畜共患病中，动物是病原体的宿主
infectious /in'fekʃəs/ adj. 有传染性的, 易传染的；[医] 传染性的
Nearly 75 percent of new, or emerging, infectious diseases in people were first spread by animals.
中文语境：近 75% 的人类新发传染病首先是由动物传播的
sicken /'sikən/ v.t. 患病, 使厌倦, 使恶心；v.i. 生病, 作呕

In zoonotic diseases, animals serve as a pathogen's host . Over time, some long-term hosts no longer become sickened. When a virus commonly lives inside an animal without harming it, that host is now called a reservoir . For instance, birds - especially ducks - have evolved into a natural reservoir for flu viruses.
中文语境：在人畜共患病中，动物是病原体的宿主。随着时间的推移，一些长期宿主不再生病。当病毒通常生活在动物体内而不伤害动物时，该宿主现在被称为宿主。例如，鸟类--尤其是鸭子--已经进化成为流感病毒的天然宿主
viral /'vairəl/ adj. 病毒的, 病毒引起的；[医] 病毒的
This viral disease started in Southeast Asia during the late 1990s.
中文语境：这种病毒性疾病于 20 世纪 90 年代末开始于东南亚
dispose /dis'pəuz/ v.t. 处理, 排列, 布置；v.i. 处置
One million pigs were killed and disposed of to stop the disease's spread.
中文语境：为了阻止疾病的传播，一百万头猪被宰杀和处理
stoke /stəuk/ v. 司炉, (使)大吃
Increasing their body fat during the day is like stoking the fire before going to bed.
中文语境：白天增加身体脂肪就像睡前火上浇油
stash /stæʃ/ v.t. 藏起来；n. 隐藏处, 隐藏物
They stash away bugs, seeds, or fat from dead animals, tucking these morsels into crevices in tree bark.
中文语境：他们把虫子、种子或死去动物的脂肪藏起来，把这些东西塞进树皮的缝隙里
optional /'ɒpʃənl/ adj. 可选择的, 随意的；[化] 选购的
"It's not optional, Nothukula," Ms.
中文语境："这不是可选的，Nothukula，"女士说
unfeeling /.ʌn'fiːliŋ/ adj. 无感觉的, 无情的, 冷酷的
They're so cold, and unfeeling, as if I am invisible.
中文语境：他们如此冷酷无情，仿佛我是隐形的
scruffy /'skrʌfi/ adj. 不整齐的, 肮脏的, 破旧的, 褴褛的
Kojo carefully placed his worn, scruffy bag on the table and spread his meal before him.
中文语境：Kojo小心翼翼地将他破旧、肮脏的包放在桌子上，然后将饭菜铺在他面前
culinary /'kʌlinəri/ adj. 厨房的, 烹调用的
Some days, at his old school, the cafeteria looked like the International House of Culinary Cuisine.
中文语境：有时候，在他原来的学校，自助餐厅看起来就像国际烹饪之家
